questions.question: Simplify (3x + 2)² + (3x - 2)² .
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the direct algebraic identity: (a + b)² + (a − b)² = 2(a² + b²)

Here, a = 3x and b = 2.

⇒ 2 × ((3x)² + 2²)

⇒ 2 × (9x² + 4)

⇒ 18x² + 8

**∴ The correct answer is 18x² + 8.**

questions.question: If the third proportional of 9 and 48 is x, then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The third proportional of two numbers a and b is given directly by the formula: x = b² / a

Here, a = 9 and b = 48.

⇒ Third proportional (x) = (48 × 48) / 9

⇒ x = 16 × 16 = 256

**∴ The correct answer is 256.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

First number (a) = 9

Second number (b) = 48

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c are in continued proportion, then a : b :: b : c, which means a / b = b / c.

Here, c is the third proportional.

questions.question: P is two years older than Q who is twice as old as R. If the total of the ages of P, Q and R be 27 years, then how old is Q?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume R = 1 unit

Then Q = 2 units and P = 4 units

Total = 7 units, but extra +2 years in P ⇒ adjust using equation

Quick solving gives x = 5 ⇒ Q = 2x = 10

**∴ Answer = 10**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

P is two years older than Q, Q is twice R, total age = 27

**Formula used:**

Forming linear equations

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let R = x

⇒ Q = 2x

⇒ P = 2x + 2

⇒ Total = (2x + 2) + 2x + x = 27

⇒ 5x + 2 = 27

⇒ 5x = 25

⇒ x = 5

⇒ Q = 2x = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Age Equations

Convert relations into algebra: twice means 2x, older means + constant.

Equation Solving

Combine all expressions into one equation and solve stepwise.

Ratio Insight

Basic ratio before adjustment: P:Q:R = 4:2:1, but constant addition modifies it.

questions.question: A certain sum of money doubles itself in 16 years on simple interest. In how many years it will be six times?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In Simple Interest, amount grows linearly with time

Doubling means interest = 1P in 16 years

Six times means interest = 5P

Time ∝ Interest ⇒ Required time = 16 × 5

**∴ Answer = 80 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A sum doubles in 16 years on simple interest

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ When amount doubles ⇒ SI = P

⇒ So, P = (P × R × 16) ÷ 100

⇒ 1 = (R × 16) ÷ 100

⇒ R = 100 ÷ 16

⇒ Now for six times ⇒ SI = 5P

⇒ 5P = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 5 = (R × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 5 = ((100 ÷ 16) × T) ÷ 100

⇒ 5 = T ÷ 16

⇒ T = 80 years

**∴ The correct answer is 80 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Growth

In SI, interest increases linearly with time. Amount = P + SI.

Doubling Time

If principal doubles in T years, then SI earned = P in T years.

Multiplication Rule

If amount becomes n times, SI = (n − 1)P, and time scales accordingly.

questions.question: Nisha buys a mobile phone for her child. The phone is marked at ₹24,500 and is offered with two successive discounts of 20% and C%, respectively. After receiving both discounts, she pays ₹13,132. Find the value of C.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive discount formula: Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁) × (1 − d₂)

13132 = 24500 × 0.8 × (1 − C/100)

13132 = 19600 × (1 − C/100)

(1 − C/100) = 13132 ÷ 19600 = 0.67

**∴ C = 33%**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price = 24500, Discounts = 20% and C%, Final Price = 13132

**Formula used:**

Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

**Calculation:**

⇒ After first discount: Price = 24500 × 80/100 = 19600

⇒ After second discount: 19600 × (100 − C)/100 = 13132

⇒ 19600 × (100 − C) = 1313200

⇒ 100 − C = 1313200 ÷ 19600 = 67

⇒ C = 33

**∴ The correct answer is 33%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount Formula

Net price = MP × (1 − a/100) × (1 − b/100)

Equivalent Discount

Equivalent discount = a + b − (a × b)/100

Quick Ratio Method

Convert discounts into multipliers like 80%, 70% and multiply directly.

questions.question: When x is added to each of 25, 11, 34 and 13, then the numbers so obtained, in this order, are in proportion. Then, if 9x : y :: y : (8x - 7) , and y > 0 , what is the value of y?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

(25 + x) : (11 + x) :: (34 + x) : (13 + x)

Cross multiply ⇒ (25 + x)(13 + x) = (11 + x)(34 + x)

Simplify ⇒ 325 + 38x + x² = 374 + 45x + x² ⇒ 7x = −49 ⇒ x = −7

Now 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7) ⇒ y² = 9x(8x − 7)

y² = 9(−7)(−63) = 3969 ⇒ y = 63 (since y > 0)

**∴ Answer = 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(25 + x), (11 + x), (34 + x), (13 + x) are in proportion

Also, 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7), y > 0

**Formula used:**

a : b :: c : d ⇒ ad = bc

**Calculation:**

⇒ (25 + x) : (11 + x) :: (34 + x) : (13 + x)

⇒ (25 + x)(13 + x) = (11 + x)(34 + x)

⇒ 325 + 38x + x² = 374 + 45x + x²

⇒ 38x − 45x = 374 − 325

⇒ −7x = 49 ⇒ x = −7

⇒ 9x : y :: y : (8x − 7)

⇒ y² = 9x(8x − 7)

⇒ y² = 9(−7)(−63) = 3969

⇒ y = √3969 = 63 (since y > 0)

**∴ The correct answer is 63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Proportion Rule

If a : b :: c : d then ad = bc (cross multiplication rule)

Quadratic Formation

Equating cross products often cancels x² terms and gives linear equation

Mean Proportion

If a : b :: b : c then b² = ac

Positive Root Condition

If y > 0, take only positive square root

questions.question: If the profit on selling an article for ₹986 is the same as the loss incurred on selling it for ₹726, then the cost price of the article is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If profit at one SP equals loss at another SP, then Cost Price = average of both SPs

CP = (986 + 726) ÷ 2

CP = 1712 ÷ 2

CP = 856

**∴ Answer = 856**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price 1 = 986 (profit), Selling Price 2 = 726 (loss)

**Formula used:**

Profit = SP − CP and Loss = CP − SP

**Calculation:**

⇒ Profit = 986 − CP

⇒ Loss = CP − 726

⇒ Given Profit = Loss

⇒ 986 − CP = CP − 726

⇒ 986 + 726 = 2CP

⇒ 1712 = 2CP

⇒ CP = 856

**∴ The correct answer is 856.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Equal Profit & Loss Concept

When profit at one SP equals loss at another, CP is the average of the two SPs.

Profit Formula

Profit = SP − CP

Loss Formula

Loss = CP − SP

questions.question: The cost of a washing machine is 50% less than the cost of a TV. If the cost of the washing machine increases by 53% and that of the TV decreases by 55%, then what is the percentage change in the total cost of 8 washing machines and 2 TVs?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let TV = 100 units ⇒ Washing Machine = 50 units

Initial total = 8 × 50 + 2 × 100 = 400 + 200 = 600

After change: WM = 50 × 1.53 = 76.5, TV = 100 × 0.45 = 45

New total = 8 × 76.5 + 2 × 45 = 612 + 90 = 702

**∴ % change = (702 − 600) ÷ 600 × 100 = 17% increase**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Washing Machine cost is 50% less than TV; WM increases by 53%, TV decreases by 55%

**Formula used:**

Percentage change = (New − Old) ÷ Old × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let TV cost = 100 ⇒ WM cost = 50

⇒ Initial total cost = 8 × 50 + 2 × 100 = 600

⇒ New WM cost = 50 × 153/100 = 76.5

⇒ New TV cost = 100 × 45/100 = 45

⇒ New total cost = 8 × 76.5 + 2 × 45 = 702

⇒ Change = 702 − 600 = 102

⇒ % change = (102 ÷ 600) × 100 = 17%

**∴ The correct answer is 17% increase.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Assumption Method

Assume convenient values like 100 to simplify percentage calculations.

Successive Percentage Change

Increase = multiply by (1 + x/100), Decrease = multiply by (1 − x/100).

Weighted Total Change

When quantities differ, compute total before and after instead of averaging percentages.

questions.question: If 20% of a number is added to 60, then the result is the same number. 80% of the same number is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the complete number be 100%.

According to the question: 20% of the number + 60 = 100% of the number.

⇒ 100% − 20% = 60

⇒ 80% of the number = 60

The question directly asks for 80% of the same number, which is exactly 60.

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 60 = the number

**Concept Used:**

Any complete quantity is always considered as 100% of itself.

 
 
 
• 
 20%
 80% = 60
 

 100% (The Complete Number)
 

 Added Value = 60

**Calculations:**

Let the unknown number be x.

⇒ 20% of x + 60 = x

⇒ (20 ÷ 100) × x + 60 = x

⇒ x − 0.20x = 60

⇒ x(1 − 0.20) = 60

⇒ 0.80x = 60

⇒ 80% of x = 60

Since the question asks us to find 80% of the same number, we already have the required value.

**∴ The correct answer is 60.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Base Value in Percentages

Every quantity in its original or complete state is always considered as 100%. When a part is given as p%, the remaining part is simply (100 − p)%.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

Fractions can be easily converted to percentages by multiplying by 100. For example, 1/5 × 100 = 20%, and 4/5 × 100 = 80%.

questions.question: A girl is standing 15 m away from a vertical flagpole. She observes . the top of the flagpole at an angle of elevation of 30º . Find the 3 height of the flagpole.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Height of an object = Distance from object × tan(θ)

Given, Distance = 15 m and θ = 30°

Height = 15 × tan(30°)

Height = 15 × (1/√3) = 15√3 ÷ 3 = 5√3 m

**∴ The correct answer is 5√3 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of the girl from the base of the flagpole (BC) = 15 m

Angle of elevation of the top of the flagpole (θ) = 30°

Let the height of the vertical flagpole (AB) be h.

**Formula Used:**

tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ In right-angled ΔABC, tan(30°) = AB ÷ BC

⇒ 1/√3 = h ÷ 15

⇒ h = 15 ÷ √3

⇒ Rationalizing the denominator: h = (15 × √3) ÷ (√3 × √3)

⇒ h = 15√3 ÷ 3

⇒ h = 5√3 m

**∴ The correct answer is 5√3 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when an observer looks upwards at an object. Determined using tan(θ) = Perpendicular ÷ Base.

Angle of Depression

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when an observer looks downwards at an object. The angle of elevation from the object is always equal to the alternate angle of depression from the observer.

Important Trigonometric Values

For solving heights and distances quickly, memorize key values: tan(30°) = 1/√3, tan(45°) = 1, and tan(60°) = √3.
</p

questions.question: One pipe can fill a tank in 8 minutes, while another pipe can empty the completely filled tank in 16 minutes. If both the pipes are opened together when the tank is empty, how many minutes will it take to fill one-fourth of the tank?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net part filled by both pipes in 1 minute = (1/8) − (1/16) = 1/16

This means the completely empty tank will be filled in 16 minutes.

Time taken to fill 1/4th of the tank = 16 × (1/4) = 4 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 4 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by filling pipe (Pipe A) = 8 minutes

Time taken by emptying pipe (Pipe B) = 16 minutes

Let total capacity of the tank be the LCM of 8 and 16.

 
 

 **Pipe**
 **Minutes**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 Pipe A (Fill)
 8
 16
 +2
 
 

 Pipe B (Empty)
 16
 −1
 
 

⇒ Combined efficiency of both pipes = (+2) + (−1) = +1 unit/min

⇒ We need to fill one-fourth of the tank.

⇒ Target capacity = 1/4 × Total Work = 1/4 × 16 = 4 units

⇒ Time required = Target capacity ÷ Combined efficiency

⇒ Time required = 4 ÷ 1 = 4 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 4 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Inlet and Outlet Pipes

An inlet pipe fills the tank (positive work), while an outlet pipe empties it (negative work). The net efficiency is the algebraic sum of their individual efficiencies.

Combined Rate Formula

If pipe A fills in x hours and pipe B empties in y hours (where y > x), the net part filled in 1 hour is (1/x − 1/y). The total time to fill the tank is xy ÷ (y − x).

Partial Work

Time required for a partial job = (Fraction of work × Total Capacity) ÷ Net Efficiency.

questions.question: The fraction form of the decimal number 0.595959 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a pure recurring decimal in the form 0.XYXYXY..., the fraction is simply the repeating digits divided by the same number of 9s.

Here, the decimal is 0.595959... where the repeating block is 59.

Since there are exactly 2 repeating digits, we place 59 over two 9s.

Fraction = 59 ÷ 99

**∴ The correct answer is 59/99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The recurring decimal number is 0.595959...

**Method Used:**

Algebraic multiplication method to eliminate the infinite recurring decimal portion.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let x = 0.595959... (Equation 1)

⇒ Since there are 2 digits repeating, we multiply both sides by 10² (which is 100).

⇒ 100x = 59.595959... (Equation 2)

⇒ Subtract Equation 1 from Equation 2:

⇒ 100x − x = 59.595959... − 0.595959...

⇒ 99x = 59

⇒ x = 59 ÷ 99

**∴ The correct answer is 59/99.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pure Recurring Decimals

A decimal number where all digits immediately after the decimal point repeat continuously. To convert into a fraction, write the repeating block as the numerator and put as many 9s in the denominator as there are repeating digits. Example: 0.777... = 7/9.

Mixed Recurring Decimals

A decimal where some digits do not repeat before the repeating sequence begins. The formula is (Total number formed by all digits − Non-repeating part) ÷ (As many 9s as repeating digits followed by as many 0s as non-repeating digits). Example: 0.12555... = (125 − 12) ÷ 900 = 113/900.

questions.question: In quadrilateral PQRS, the bisectors of ∠R and ∠S meet at the point T (inside the quadrilateral) and ∠STR = 37.5°. If the ratio of ∠P to ∠Q is 7 : 8, then what is the difference between the measures of ∠Q and ∠P?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Angle between bisectors of two adjacent angles of a quadrilateral = ½ × (Sum of other two angles)

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 2 × 37.5° = 75°

⇒ Total ratio units = 7 + 8 = 15 units

⇒ 15 units = 75° ⇒ 1 unit = 5°

⇒ Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 8 units − 7 units = 1 unit = 5°

**∴ The correct answer is 5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 P (7x) Q (8x) R S T 37.5° 

**Given:**

∠STR = 37.5°

Ratio of ∠P to ∠Q = 7 : 8

**Formula Used:**

Sum of all interior angles in a quadrilateral is 360°.

Sum of interior angles in a triangle is 180°.

**Calculation:**

⇒ In ΔSTR, ∠STR + ∠TRS + ∠TSR = 180°

⇒ 37.5° + ∠R/2 + ∠S/2 = 180°

⇒ ½ × (∠R + ∠S) = 180° − 37.5°

⇒ ½ × (∠R + ∠S) = 142.5°

⇒ ∠R + ∠S = 142.5° × 2 = 285°

⇒ In quadrilateral PQRS, ∠P + ∠Q + ∠R + ∠S = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q + 285° = 360°

⇒ ∠P + ∠Q = 75°

Let ∠P = 7x and ∠Q = 8x

⇒ 7x + 8x = 75°

⇒ 15x = 75°

⇒ x = 5°

⇒ Difference between ∠Q and ∠P = 8x − 7x = x

⇒ Difference = 5°

**∴ The correct answer is 5°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle Between Bisectors of Adjacent Angles

In any quadrilateral, the angle formed by the intersection of the bisectors of two adjacent angles is equal to half the sum of the remaining two interior angles. Formula: ∠STR = ½ × (∠P + ∠Q).

Angle Between Bisectors of Opposite Angles

The angle formed by the bisectors of two opposite angles of a non-cyclic quadrilateral is equal to half the difference of the other two opposite interior angles.

Cyclic Quadrilateral Property

If a quadrilateral is cyclic (all four vertices lie on a circle), then the sum of its opposite angles is strictly 180°.

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 66 days. B is 45% less efficient than A. C is 50% more efficient than B. If B and C work together for 24 days, then A alone will complete the remaining work in:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of A : B : C = 100 : 55 : 82.5 = 40 : 22 : 33.

Total work = Efficiency of A × Time = 40 × 66 = 2640 units.

Work done by B and C in 24 days = (22 + 33) × 24 = 1320 units.

Remaining work = 2640 − 1320 = 1320 units.

Time for A to complete remaining work = 1320 ÷ 40 = 33 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A can complete the work in 66 days.

B is 45% less efficient than A.

C is 50% more efficient than B.

B and C work together for 24 days.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A

 C

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of A = 100 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of B = 100 − 45% of 100 = 55 units/day.

⇒ Efficiency of C = 55 + 50% of 55 = 82.5 units/day.

⇒ Simplifying the ratio of efficiencies A : B : C = 100 : 55 : 82.5 = 40 : 22 : 33.

⇒ Total work = 40 × 66 = 2640 units.

⇒ Time taken by B = 2640 ÷ 22 = 120 days.

⇒ Time taken by C = 2640 ÷ 33 = 80 days.

⇒ Combined efficiency of B and C = 22 + 33 = 55 units/day.

⇒ Work done by B and C in 24 days = 55 × 24 = 1320 units.

⇒ Remaining work = 2640 − 1320 = 1320 units.

⇒ Time taken by A to complete remaining work = 1320 ÷ 40 = 33 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 33 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes and Cisterns

Works on the same concept as Time & Work. Inlet pipes have positive efficiency, and outlet pipes have negative efficiency.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in direct proportion to the actual amount of work done by each individual. If they work for the exact same number of days, wages are directly distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When people work on alternate days, find the total work done in one cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and determine how many complete cycles fit into the total work before solving for the remaining individual days.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 49?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the positive osculator method for 49 (since 49 + 1 = 50 → osculator is +5).

Multiply the last digit by 5 and add it to the remaining part successively.

Testing 7132979: 713297 + (9 × 5) = 713342 ⇒ 71334 + (2 × 5) = 71344

⇒ 7134 + (4 × 5) = 7154 ⇒ 715 + (4 × 5) = 735 ⇒ 73 + (5 × 5) = 98

Since 98 is exactly 49 × 2, the original number 7132979 is perfectly divisible by 49.

**∴ The correct answer is 7132979.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Numbers: 7311476, 7132979, 7492470, 6697359

**Method Used:**

A number is divisible by 49 if it is perfectly divisible by 7 twice consecutively (since 49 = 7 × 7), or we can divide each option directly by 49.

**Calculations:**

Checking Option 1: 7311476

⇒ 7311476 ÷ 49 = 149213 remainder 39 (Not completely divisible)

Checking Option 2: 7132979

⇒ 7132979 ÷ 7 = 1018997 (Divisible by 7)

⇒ 1018997 ÷ 7 = 145571 (Divisible by 7 again)

⇒ Therefore, 7132979 is completely divisible by 49.

Checking Option 3: 7492470

⇒ 7492470 ÷ 49 = 152907 remainder 27 (Not completely divisible)

Checking Option 4: 6697359

⇒ 6697359 ÷ 49 = 136680 remainder 39 (Not completely divisible)

**∴ The correct answer is 7132979.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Positive Osculator Method

For numbers ending in 9 (like 9, 19, 29, 39, 49), add 1 to get a multiple of 10. Drop the zero to find the osculator. Multiply the last digit of the given number by this osculator and add it to the rest of the number repeatedly.

Divisibility Rule of 7

Double the last digit of the number and subtract it from the remaining number. If the result is divisible by 7, the original number is also divisible by 7.

Divisibility Rule of 13

Multiply the last digit by 4 and add it to the remaining number. Repeat this process until the number is small enough to verify divisibility by 13.
</p

questions.question: The arithmetic mean of the observations 21, 23, 38, 99, 64, 35, 48, 52 and 16 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the assumed mean be 50.

Deviations from 50: −29, −27, −12, +49, +14, −15, −2, +2, −34

Sum of deviations = (−29) + (−27) + (−12) + 49 + 14 + (−15) + (−2) + 2 + (−34) = −54

Average deviation = −54 ÷ 9 = −6

Actual Mean = Assumed Mean + Average deviation = 50 − 6 = 44.

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Observations: 21, 23, 38, 99, 64, 35, 48, 52, 16

Total number of observations (n) = 9

**Formula Used:**

Arithmetic Mean = (Sum of all observations) ÷ (Total number of observations)

 
 Data: 21, 23, 38, 99, 64, 35, 48, 52, 16
 
 
 Total Sum = 396

 
 Mean = 396 ÷ 9 = 44

 

 

 ÷ n (9)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Sum of observations = 21 + 23 + 38 + 99 + 64 + 35 + 48 + 52 + 16

⇒ Sum of observations = 396

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 396 ÷ 9

⇒ Arithmetic Mean = 44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Mean

The most common measure of central tendency, calculated as the sum of all values divided by the total number of values.

Assumed Mean Method

A calculation trick where an arbitrary central value is chosen, and the actual mean is adjusted by adding the average deviation of all data points from this assumed value.

Median

The exact middle value when a set of numbers is ordered by size. For an even number of items, it's the average of the two middlemost numbers.
</p

questions.question: {Simplify}: sqrt{5 + sqrt{25} + 5² - 3² - 10} - sqrt{4}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply BODMAS and solve orders (powers and roots) directly in one step.

Expression: √(5 + √25 + 5² − 3² − 10) − √4

⇒ √(5 + 5 + 25 − 9 − 10) − 2

⇒ √(35 − 19) − 2

⇒ √(16) − 2 = 4 − 2 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = √(5 + √25 + 5² − 3² − 10) − √4

**Concept Used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction).

**Calculation:**

First, resolve the squares and square roots (Orders) inside the main square root.

⇒ √25 = 5

⇒ 5² = 25

⇒ 3² = 9

⇒ √4 = 2

Substitute these values back into the expression:

⇒ √(5 + 5 + 25 − 9 − 10) − 2

Perform the addition inside the bracket:

⇒ √(10 + 25 − 9 − 10) − 2

⇒ √(35 − 9 − 10) − 2

Perform the subtraction inside the bracket:

⇒ √(26 − 10) − 2

⇒ √16 − 2

Resolve the final square root:

⇒ 4 − 2

⇒ 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

An acronym to remember the order of operations in arithmetic: Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Perfect Squares and Roots

Squaring a number means multiplying it by itself (e.g., 5 × 5 = 25). The square root operation is its inverse, finding the value that was squared to yield the number (e.g., √25 = 5). For pure simplification, the principal (positive) square root is always considered.
</p

questions.question: Walking at (3)/(4)th of his normal speed from his home, Manish is 8 minutes late in reaching his office. The usual time taken by him to cover the distance between his home and his office is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Speed becomes 3/4 ⇒ Time becomes 4/3

Extra time = (4/3 − 1) = 1/3 of normal time

(1/3) × T = 8 ⇒ T = 24

**∴ Answer = 24 minutes**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Reduced speed = 3/4 of normal speed

Delay = 8 minutes

**Formula used:**

Time ∝ 1 / Speed

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let normal time = T

⇒ New time = T × (4/3)

⇒ Delay = New time − Normal time

⇒ T × (4/3) − T = 8

⇒ T(4/3 − 1) = 8

⇒ T × (1/3) = 8

⇒ T = 24

**∴ The correct answer is 24 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed-Time Relation

Time is inversely proportional to speed for fixed distance

Ratio Concept

If speed becomes a/b, time becomes b/a

Delay Formula

Delay = New time − Original time

Shortcut Insight

Extra time fraction directly helps find original time

questions.question: If the cost of 13 kg onions is ₹273, cost of 21 kg tomatoes is ₹462 and the cost of 27 kg potatoes is ₹ 594, then find the total cost of 21 kg onions, 25 kg tomatoes and 32 kg potatoes.

Onion rate = 273 ÷ 13 = 21

Tomato rate = 462 ÷ 21 = 22

Potato rate = 594 ÷ 27 = 22

Total cost = 21×21 + 25×22 + 32×22

= 441 + 550 + 704 = 1695

**∴ Answer = 1695**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

13 kg onions = 273, 21 kg tomatoes = 462, 27 kg potatoes = 594

**Formula used:**

Unit price = Total cost ÷ Quantity

**Calculation:**

⇒ Onion price per kg = 273 ÷ 13 = 21

⇒ Tomato price per kg = 462 ÷ 21 = 22

⇒ Potato price per kg = 594 ÷ 27 = 22

⇒ Cost of 21 kg onions = 21 × 21 = 441

⇒ Cost of 25 kg tomatoes = 25 × 22 = 550

⇒ Cost of 32 kg potatoes = 32 × 22 = 704

⇒ Total cost = 441 + 550 + 704 = 1695

**∴ The correct answer is 1695.**

Unitary Method

Find cost per unit first, then multiply by required quantity

Direct Proportion

Cost ∝ Quantity when rate is constant

Quick Division Trick

Break numbers into factors for faster division

Efficiency Tip

Always compute unit rates first to simplify multi-item problems

questions.question: A class of 38 students took a Physics test. 14 students had an average score of 68. The remaining students had an average score of 73. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining students = 38 − 14 = 24

Use weighted average:

Average = (14×68 + 24×73) ÷ 38

= (952 + 1752) ÷ 38 = 2704 ÷ 38

= 71.157... ≈ 71.2

**∴ Answer = 71.2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students = 38

14 students → average = 68

Remaining 24 students → average = 73

**Formula used:**

Average = Total marks ÷ Total students

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total marks of 14 students = 14 × 68 = 952

⇒ Total marks of 24 students = 24 × 73 = 1752

⇒ Total marks = 952 + 1752 = 2704

⇒ Average = 2704 ÷ 38 = 71.157...

⇒ Rounded off = 71.2

**∴ The correct answer is 71.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Average = (Σ f×x) ÷ Σ f

Combined Mean

Combined average = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Shortcut Concept

Use weighted method instead of finding individual values

Rounding Rule

Round to one decimal place as per question requirement
